_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A paste bigger than a websocket message reaches the program. The test seeded a conversation at /c/term-paste, whose directory holds paste.sh, which prints "paste-ready" and then writes the next 600 lines it reads to the file "got". window.__paste is the text to paste: 600 lines, over 32 KiB as a websocket message. Call "got" compares the file "got" with that text; it returns "same" once they are equal. To choose a terminal menu item, click the button with aria-label exactly "Terminal menu", then the button with exactly that text inside ".overflow-menu-panel" (two real clicks). 
1. Navigate to /c/term-paste. Fill [data-testid="message-input"] with "!bash paste.sh" and click [data-testid="send-button"].
2. Retry the following steps as one block until they pass (timeout 15s): choose the terminal menu item "Insert all output into input" (both clicks inside the block); then the message input's value must contain "paste-ready" (eval with expect true).
3. Paste: in one eval, on the terminal input ('.terminal-panel-content [data-terminal-id][style*="display: block"] textarea[aria-label="Terminal input"]'), make a DataTransfer, setData("text/plain", window.__paste) on it, and dispatch on the textarea a new ClipboardEvent("paste", {clipboardData: that DataTransfer, bubbles: true, cancelable: true}).
4. There should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab-success".
5. Call "got" should return "same".

steps.expression: (function() { var ta = document.querySelector('.terminal-panel-content [data-terminal-id][style*="display: block"] textarea[aria-label="Terminal input"]'); var dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.setData('text/plain', window.__paste); ta.dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent('paste', {clipboardData: dt, bubbles: true, cancelable: true})); })()
